Mali.title: Confederation of Sahel States: BAMEX as a Unified Force Accelerator
Mali.summary: By focusing on the interoperability of equipment and the pooling of tactical capabilities, the Bamako gathering illustrates the unwavering political will of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger to build a community space totally secured by and for Sahelians . The guidelines recalled at the official opening by the Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence and Veterans Affairs, Major General Oumar Diarra, underline this dynamic: the rise of the Unified Force is not only based on the commitment of men to combat, but on the harmonization of their technological and logistical means .

Mali.title: The Red Cross is stepping up its assistance at reception sites
Mali.summary: CURRENTLY IN MAMARIBOUGOU, the teams of the Malian Red Cross provided food and medical assistance to people settled on the site on Friday, November 6. This operation extends the first distributions made the day before in several reception centres in the Bamako District. The note circulated by the organization quotes Ouezzinbougou, Mamaribougou and Djicoroni-Koura .

Mali.title: West Africa: Eviction of Burkinabe gold miners from Guinea - Lessons to be learned
Mali.summary: On 2 November, the Guinean authorities decided to put an end to illegal gold panning in their country, particularly in the north-east of the country. According to them, this practice poses a threat not only to the environment, but also to human and animal health. In Siguiri, for example, they say, many people have been hospitalized because of the use of cyanide Many animals have died, not to mention the massive destruction of forests and the pollution of waterways.

Mali.title: Assimi Goïta in Russia: The Malian president and Vladimir Putin’s blonde escort
Mali.summary: Footage broadcast by ORTM, Mali’s national television channel, documented Malian President Assimi Goïta during his visit to Moscow for the third Russia-Africa summit, on 28 and 29 October. Goïta watched a shooting exercise at a Russian army base. After observing the local soldiers in action, the Malian head of state took his turn.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: terrorists neutralized in the Ménaka and Kidal sectors
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 9 (AMAP) The General Staff of the Armed Forces announced on Sunday that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, have successfully carried out several strikes against groups of armed terrorist groups with war materiel, in the Ménaka and Kidal sectors, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces, the use of precise intelligence made it possible, on Friday, November 6, 2026, to locate a group of terrorists about 50 kilometers southwest of the city of Menaka.

Mali.title: Ménaka and Kidal: Several groupings...
Mali.summary: Menaka and Kidal: Several terrorist groups neutralized by the FAMa As part of the Dougoukoloko security operation, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted airstrikes and targeted interventions on 6 and 7 November 2026 .

Mali.title: Mali: "At one point, I stopped counting deaths," says El Bachir Thiam, a former State Security detainee
Mali.summary: In Mali, it has been a little over a year since El Bachir Thiam was released from the jails of the State Security of Mali.

Burkina Faso.title: Bandits burn 12 family members
Burkina Faso.summary: Twelve members of the same family have been killed after armed bandits set their residence ablaze during an attack on Gidan Taba village in Maradun Local Government Area of Zamfara State. Seven other residents were also abducted during the attack, which occurred on Saturday night in Dosara Birnin Kaya Ward, despite efforts by the community to alert security agencies.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: A collision between two buses kills six people in Ipendo on the RN1
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso: A collision between two buses leaves six dead in Ipendo on the RN1 A traffic accident bereaved the national road No.1 (RN1) on the night of Sunday, November 8 to Monday, November 9, 2026, report our colleagues at Sidwaya Publishing. According to published information, the accident occurred in Ipendo, a village about seven kilometers from Sabou .

Niger.title: Defence and security: Presentation to the flag of the soldiers of the 2025 contingent at the Instruction and Training Center – CIE AGALI-
Niger.summary: On Friday, November 6, 2026, the Dosso Training and Education Center (CIE) hosted a solemn ceremony of presentation to the national flag of the soldiers of contingent 2025 This major event took place in the presence of many military, administrative, customary and religious authorities in the region, thus testifying to the importance given to the training and engagement of young recruits of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN) .

Niger.title: Deployment in Niger: the EU becomes the new battleground between Algiers and Paris
Niger.summary: After EU statements on the deployment of Algerian troops in Niger, Algiers accuses Paris of being behind this position. A new diplomatic arms pass that buries a little more hopes of warming between the two countries .

Niger.title: Niger and Chad’s drone-strike row exposes deep rifts in the Sahel
Niger.summary: Niger’s junta in October accused neighbouring Chad of a drone strike that killed two civilians on its soil – and of acting with French support. Within days, the two countries’ foreign ministers were smiling side-by-side in Moscow. But differences over security and geopolitics make a swift reconciliation unlikely.

Niger.title: Niger-Chad: between Abdourahamane Tiani and Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno, the peace of the brave is not for tomorrow
Niger.summary: After the diplomatic escalation of October 26, Niamey and N’Djamena try to defuse tensions. But the security and geopolitical differences between the leaders of the two countries make a quick return to peaceful relations unlikely. Abdourahamane Tiani is an unpredictable leader On 26 October, at its initiative, the Nigerien government issued a vitriolic communiqué, accompanied by threats and warnings against its neighbour Chad.

Niger.title: Agadez: Regional Security Council meeting focused on assessing the security situation
Niger.summary: Agadez, 9 November (ANP) – The Governor of the Agadez Region, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS) on Monday, 9 November 2026. Several items were on the agenda of this meeting, including the assessment of the security situation in the region . The Regional Security Council, it is noted, is a body bringing together the defence and security forces and civilian personalities concerned with security issues.
